shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md package.json next.config.ts tsconfig.json && rg --files app'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && find app -type f -maxdepth 6 -print -exec cat {} \\;"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx && rg -n 'dynamicIO|experimental_ppr|force-dynamic|force-static|export const (dynamic|revalidate|fetchCache)|instant\\s*[:=]\\s*false|cacheComponents' app next.config.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- .gitignore tsconfig.json && git status --short --branch'
/bin/bash -lc 'git add .gitignore next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx tsconfig.json && git commit -m "Migrate publishing routes to Cache Components" && git status --short --branch'
